title: Sage hit_location record
description: A hit_location record (HitLocationRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another hit_location record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

damageMultiplier.description: The strike's damage is multiplied by this here: 2 for a head, 0.5 for a hand. At least 0. (float, default 1)

resist.description: An attribute read as a percentage (0..95) of the damage stopped here, before the damage type's own resist: armor_head. Names a attribute record. (RecordRef<AttributeRecord>)

effects.description: Applied to the victim when a strike here gets through: a leg shot that slows, a head shot that dazes. Names a effect record. (List<RecordRef<EffectRecord>>)

effects+.description: Adds to "effects": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

effects-.description: Removes these from "effects" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

tags.description: What a game's rules read about this place (HitLocations.HasTag): vital, limb. Names a tag record. (List<RecordRef<TagRecord>>)

tags+.description: Adds to "tags": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

tags-.description: Removes these from "tags" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.
